name: Goat milk
description: Lighter and easier on the stomach than cow's milk, with a distinct tang.

tcm.note: Goat's milk is explicitly warm in TCM, tonifying — unlike cow's milk, which is neutral.

ayurveda.note: Aja dugdha is shita but light and astringent — classically given in fever, where cow's milk is too heavy.

unani.note: Treated as the most temperate of the milks, close to balanced.
